_readme: SCG members shown on /team/, grouped by level (levels, in order). Imported from the old site's About page (source: old-site). Fields: id, name, level (one of levels), title, cohort, majors (list; null until known, never guessed), experience (internship line from the old site, optional), worked_on (project ids from projects.json; optional), photo ({focal: 'x% y%'}; the file is assets/photos/people/<id>.* , made by npm run people-photos), linkedin (only if publicly linked; null otherwise), consent_to_publish (true to show), consent_basis, source. To add a person: add an entry, put their photo at assets/photos/people/<id>.jpg (or .png/.webp) and run npm run build.
